query: Since last week our export endpoint returns 504 upstream request timeout after about 15 seconds. It used to work. We're on AWS.
expected_behavior: Loads reference/networking-domains.md, not every reference file
Explains that clusters routed by Envoy Gateway use a default request timeout of 15 seconds when none is set
Asks or checks whether the cluster uses Gateway API (k8s.use_api_gateway) or NGINX Ingress before naming a setting
Recommends network.gateway_api.http_request_timeout_seconds on the service, or envoy.gateway_api.http_request_timeout_seconds on the cluster, followed by a redeploy
Uses the read, modify, write sequence if it proposes changing advanced settings through the API, and asks before writing

query: A payment provider wants a fixed IP to whitelist our outbound traffic. How do I get one on our existing EKS cluster?
expected_behavior: Loads reference/networking-domains.md
Explains the cluster Static IP feature (NAT gateways with Elastic IPs) and where to find the addresses in the AWS console
States that on AWS the Static IP feature is chosen at cluster creation and cannot be enabled on an existing cluster, so the path is a new cluster
Does not invent a setting that enables static IP on an existing AWS cluster

query: I added app.example.com as a custom domain an hour ago and the certificate is still pending. DNS is on Cloudflare.
expected_behavior: Loads reference/networking-domains.md
Asks whether the Cloudflare record is proxied or DNS only, and whether the domain is a wildcard
Suggests checking the CNAME with dig against the target shown in the Console
Explains Generate certificate for DNS-only records versus Domain behind a CDN for proxied records
Recommends a redeploy after DNS resolves, and escalation to Qovery support with the service URL if it still fails

query: How do I connect DBeaver on my laptop to the Postgres database of my staging environment?
expected_behavior: Loads reference/databases.md
Recommends qovery port-forward with the database's Console URL and a local port, rather than making the database public
Mentions the Port-forward permission on the environment type
Points to the built-in variables for credentials without printing any secret value
If the database is a managed RDS instance, explains that port-forward reaches pods and proposes another path

query: I replaced our Redis service with Valkey and now the app can't read REDIS_URL. What happened?
expected_behavior: Loads reference/secrets-env.md and/or reference/databases.md
Explains that REDIS_URL was an alias whose target was removed with the old service
Recommends re-pointing the alias with PUT /variable/{aliasId} (value is the target variable name) or the rename swap in the Console, then a redeploy
Warns against deleting the alias and recreating it, or replacing it with a plain variable holding the copied value

query: Our pods keep restarting during the night even though nobody deployed anything. Is that normal?
expected_behavior: Loads reference/kubernetes-basics.md or reference/aws-eks.md
Lists Karpenter consolidation and drift, OOM kills, liveness failures and spot reclaims as the usual causes
Explains the stable and default node pools and that single-instance services restart when their node is replaced
Recommends at least 2 instances, graceful SIGTERM handling with deployment.termination_grace_period_seconds, and the stable pool consolidation window
Hands off to qovery-troubleshoot if the user wants the restarts of a specific service diagnosed from its logs and events

query: I used the API to set one advanced setting on my app and now the service account setting is empty and the app lost access to S3.
expected_behavior: Loads reference/cli-api-terraform.md
Explains that PUT on advancedSettings replaces the whole object and omitted keys reset to defaults
Gives the GET, edit, PUT sequence with qovery api, and says to drop build.* keys for applications
Suggests the audit log to find the previous value, and asks before writing anything
Recommends a redeploy after restoring the setting

query: My deployments are refused with a billing message but we paid the invoice yesterday.
expected_behavior: Loads reference/billing-access.md
Checks billing_deployment_restriction on the organization with a read-only call
Explains that a value other than NO_CREDIT_CARD is lifted by Qovery support, and tells the user how to contact support with the invoice reference
Does not attempt to change billing or retry deployments in a loop

query: My api service in production is crash looping right now, here is the URL: https://console.qovery.com/organization/x/project/y/environment/z/application/a
expected_behavior: Recognizes a live incident on a specific service
Hands off to qovery-troubleshoot for live diagnosis, or, if it is not installed, follows reference/app-runtime.md (CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, probes) using read-only checks first
Does not change configuration or redeploy production without explicit confirmation
